item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 11:15 AM, 26 August 2026(Wednesday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Nueva Ecija(Gabaldon, Laur, Bongabon, General Mamerto Natividad, Palayan, Rizal, General Tinio), Pampanga(Porac, Floridablanca, Mabalacat, Angeles, Bacolor, Santa Rita, Sasmuan, Lubao, Guagua, San Fernando, Magalang) and Tarlac(San Jose, Capas, Bamban, Concepcion, Tarlac City) within the next 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in Zambales(Subic, Iba, Olongapo, San Antonio, Castillejos, Botolan, Cabangan) and Bataan(Abucay, Samal, Orani, Hermosa, Dinalupihan, Morong) which may persist within 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 4 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 25 August 2026(Tuesday)

Light to moderate rains are expected over Bataan, Laguna(Santa Maria, Mabitac, Pakil, Siniloan, Pangil, Famy, Paete, Lumban, Kalayaan, Cavinti), Zambales(Subic, San Antonio, Olongapo) and Tarlac(Concepcion, La Paz).

Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Rizal(Rodriguez), Bulacan(San Jose del Monte, Norzagaray, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Balagtas, Baliuag, Bocaue, Bulakan, Calumpit, Malolos, Meycauayan, Guiguinto, Hagonoy, Marilao, Obando, Pandi, Paombong, Plaridel, Pulilan, Santa Maria), Quezon(General Nakar), Metro Manila(Caloocan, Valenzuela, Malabon, Navotas), Pampanga(San Luis, San Simon, Apalit, Candaba) and Nueva Ecija(Gapan, San Isidro) and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 3 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 PM, 25 August 2026(Tuesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales and Bataan(Dinalupihan, Hermosa, Morong).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Cavite, Rizal(Rodriguez, San Mateo, Antipolo, Cainta), Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian, Calatagan, Balayan, Tuy), Nueva Ecija(Gabaldon, Zaragoza, San Antonio, Santa Rosa, General Tinio, Penaranda, San Leonardo, Jaen, San Isidro, Gapan, Cabiao, Laur, Palayan, Cabanatuan), Quezon(General Nakar) and Laguna(Calamba, Cabuyao, Santa Rosa, Binan, San Pedro) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Bataan(Abucay, Bagac, Balanga, Limay, Mariveles, Orani, Orion, Pilar, Samal), Metro Manila(Valenzuela, Caloocan, Malabon, Navotas), Pampanga(Angeles, Porac, Floridablanca, Lubao, Guagua, Santa Rita, Mabalacat), Tarlac(Capas, Bamban, San Jose, Santa Ignacia, Camiling, San Clemente, Mayantoc) and Bulacan(Meycauayan, Obando, Marilao) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
